name: Pixel 6
status: bring-up: iOS lock screen observed 2026-11-12 (run oriole-gui1); touch not yet working

notes.dram_banks: OBSERVED on the phone (run oriole-probe1 (2026-11-12, probe shim git 36cacae, image sha256 981284da), capture device/google/oriole/hardware/probe-log-2026-11-12-oriole-probe1.txt): /memory banks 0x80000000, 0x880000000, 0x900000000, 0x980000000, 2 GiB each; the high three are contiguous and merged here; no reserved range lies above 0x880000000. Android CP1A.260405.005, bootloader slider-17.0-15681480.
notes.xnu_ram: Deliberately the same 4 GiB window as bluejay (the XNU memory path is observed only with this size); it must lie inside a hole-free bank with no reserved range inside. Growing it to 6 GiB is a later, separate change.
notes.fb_base: OBSERVED on the phone (run oriole-probe1, 2026-11-12, probe shim git 36cacae): the shim draws its console at 0xfac00000 (FDT has no framebuffer node: 'FB board fallback') and the user saw the text on screen. Source: mainline Linux gs101-oriole.dts cont_splash_mem reg <0x0 0xfac00000 (1080*2400*4)>, framebuffer0 1080x2400 stride 1080*4 a8r8g8b8.
notes.usb_dma_range: OBSERVED on the phone (run oriole-probe1 (2026-11-12, probe shim git 36cacae, image sha256 981284da), capture device/google/oriole/hardware/probe-log-2026-11-12-oriole-probe1.txt): reserved-memory abl@f8800000, no-map, 16 MiB (same as bluejay); ABL's DWC3 event buffer GEVNTADR 0xF8D1B000 (4 KiB) lies inside it ('USB EVBUF in reserved abl@f8800000').
notes.key_pins: read from source: same gpio-keys as bluejay. Google raviole gs101-oriole-common.dtsi -> gs101-raviole.dtsi:8 includes gs101/gs101-common.dtsi (bluejay: gs101-bluejay.dtsi:8, the same file); mainline gs101-pixel-common.dtsi gpio-keys (gpa7-3, gpa8-1, gpa10-1, GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW) is the oriole tree. Bank offsets as in device/google/bluejay/board.json notes.
notes.touch: read from source: Google kernel/devices/google/raviole android-gs-raviole-6.1-android16 dts/gs101-oriole-touch.dtsi (st,dchip_id 0x36 0x48, st,max-coords 1079 2399, firmware ftm5_fw_o6.ftb) includes gs101/gs101-fts-touch.dtsi (st,irq-gpio gpa9 0, st,reset-gpio gpp26 0, CS gpp23-3, spi-max-frequency 10 MHz), which includes gs101-common-touch.dtsi:8-15 (SPI gpp23-0..2, TS_SPI_SEL gpp26-1, DVDD LDO25M, AVDD LDO26M). Same files as bluejay; only the panel map and IC firmware name differ.
